parsed.about_body: Vicwest Roofing has traded since 2017, with Hayden taking direct responsibility for roof replacement work across Ballarat and nearby towns. From the first measure-up to the final clean handover, he keeps the job clear: what needs replacing, what materials are being used, when the crew is booked, and what the warranty covers. The business holds VBA licence CDB-U 65938 and ABN 69 622 718 361, and focuses on metal roofing, Colorbond® re-roofs, gutters, fascia, downpipes and cladding. Homeowners often call after leaks, storm damage or an ageing tiled roof has reached the end of its life. Hayden’s local commitment is simple: leave Ballarat homes, from Alfredton to Wendouree, with a roof that is properly measured, flashed and finished.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost in Ballarat?
faqs.a: Cost depends on roof size, pitch, access, removal type, insulation, flashings and gutter work. Vicwest Roofing provides a written quote after measuring the roof and checking details such as valleys, battens and ridge caps.

faqs.q: Can you replace a leaking tiled roof with Colorbond®?
faqs.a: Yes. Vicwest Roofing handles tile-to-metal and tile-to-Colorbond® conversions, including old roof removal, new battens, sarking, sheets, flashings and ridge caps.

faqs.q: Are you licensed for roofing work in Victoria?
faqs.a: Vicwest Roofing holds VBA licence CDB-U 65938 and ABN 69 622 718 361. You can ask for these details before booking a quote.

faqs.q: How long does a re-roof take?
faqs.a: Many straightforward metal re-roofs can be completed quickly once materials and crew are scheduled. Larger homes, difficult access, asbestos cement removal or complex valleys and flashings can add time.

faqs.q: Do you offer a workmanship warranty?
faqs.a: Roof replacements include a 10-year workmanship warranty. Product warranties depend on the specific Colorbond® or metal roofing materials used on the job.
Yes. Vicwest Roofing services Ballarat and surrounding areas including Delacombe, Wendouree, Alfredton, Daylesford, Bacchus Marsh, Castlemaine, Bendigo, Geelong and Hamilton.
